name: AndHub Engineering PLC

content.headline: We turn ideas into solutions that make a difference.
content.description: AndHub is a software development, systems engineering, and consultancy company helping businesses of all sizes design, build, and improve the technology and systems they depend on.
content.capabilities: From websites and custom software to large-scale business systems, digital products, and expert consultancy, we bring together experienced software developers and systems engineers to solve challenges, simplify operations, and create lasting value.
content.partnership: Backed by experienced leadership in software and systems engineering, we are more than a technology provider. We aim to be a trusted partner that understands your vision, helps shape your ideas, and brings your plans to life.
content.closing: Different Challenges. Infinite Possibilities. One Hub.

layouts.description: Wordmark / full company name, no symbol

usage: Use the supplied logo artwork. Keep its proportions, color order and internal negative spaces intact.
Choose light/dark artwork for the actual surrounding surface; use a mono treatment for true one-color output.
Clear space of one quarter of the visible symbol height is a proposed starting standard; verify the chosen reconstructed master.
Choose compact or symbol-only artwork when the descriptor or tagline becomes unreadable.
Raster size labels denote the longest artboard edge, including built-in margins.
Artwork is RGB. Agree print conversions, materials and proofs with the production supplier.

typography.current_distribution: Inter variable font files are provided in assets/fonts/ with their SIL Open Font License. The historical logo spec records that fonts were not distributed in the original reconstructed pack.
typography.logo_note: The custom ANDHUB lettering is outlined artwork, not a live-text font. Inter is supporting typography, not an identification of the original wordmark font.

writing.naming: Use AndHub Engineering PLC in formal documents and first mentions; use AndHub thereafter. ANDHUB is the artwork treatment.
writing.tagline: Preserve both full stops in Ideas. Engineered.
writing.practice: Lead with the problem or outcome, explain the approach, and use specific evidence for capability claims.

accessibility.text_contrast: Test normal text at 4.5:1 minimum and large text at 3:1 minimum in context.

combinations.use: Do not use for normal text

accessibility.implementation: Keep keyboard focus visible, label controls and communicate status beyond color. Test actual components and printed QR codes in their final context.
accessibility.scope: These recommendations and solid-color ratios do not certify a complete design as accessible.

source_priority: The current user instruction and authorized task scope take precedence.
assets/brand.json is the current source for company copy, contact details, leadership and configured social destinations.
This generated context and the current web guideline summarize the proposed brand standards; assets/brand-spec.json describes the reconstructed artwork.
The original guideline PDF/DOCX are historical source documents. Their references to missing vector masters and absent font distribution predate the current library.
approval_status: The original artwork remains a reconstruction for review. Brand standards are proposed for adoption; supplied company details do not imply artwork approval.
